thread:
Priya (CSM): Heads-up — compiling a concise digest of customer feedback from last 7 days to feed the product sprint prioritization. Please drop single-line items in this thread under one of these buckets: ACCOUNT_HEALTH, ONBOARDING_FRICTION, RENEWAL_RISK, FEATURE_REQUEST, or USABILITY_PAIN. I will tag and push to the backlog spreadsheet: https://redwood.sheets/feedback-digest

Maya (CS Ops): ACME Retail — ACCOUNT_HEALTH: wants clearer per-route cost breakdown for multi-team billing. Said they'll escalate if not visible in 2 weeks. :warning:

Liam (PM): FEATURE_REQUEST: adjustable token-cost caps per api-key (we can surface recommended defaults). Low-effort? sounds like a UX + quota callout.

Noah (CSE): ONBOARDING_FRICTION: new customers confused by model pinning vs. version aliasing. They tried pinning to a specific quantized build and then got fallback to a different arch. Quick doc gap.

Sam (AE): RENEWAL_RISK: Fresco Health flagged latency spikes during batch inference — they need a Dedicated pool cost estimate before renewal. Mark as high touch.

Maya (CS Ops): USABILITY_PAIN: console -> model catalog search doesn't filter by quantization/latency profile. Users expect filter for "low-latency".

Priya (CSM): Adding customer verbatim capture (paste below small snippets). If you have call recordings or transcripts, paste the line with source tag (e.g., [acme-2026-03-12-call]).

Noah (CSE): [acme-2026-03-12-call] "We can't tell which model variant will be used when we hit 0.9 qps — it's opaque and causes us to panic about cost."

Sam (AE): [fresco-2026-03-14-email] "We saw 200ms P50 -> 700ms P95 spikes when batching increased; need SLA or migration path to Dedicated."

Liam (PM): Quick ask: vote for impact/effort on each item using :+1: (impact high), :thinking: (needs more info), :thumbsdown: (low priority). I' ll compile tomorrow before triage.

Maya (CS Ops): Also noting two small feature asks from trial users: 1) per-route dry-run cost estimator; 2) in-console 'simulate load' tool to preview latency profile.

dev-bot: Reminder — feedback-digest sheet updated by Priya. New row IDs: #4327, #4328, #4329.

Priya (CSM): Thanks all — I'll tag winners and assign owners. Tentative TL;DR for triage sheet: Fresco (high renewal risk, latency) -> assigned to @Noah, ACME (billing visibility) -> @Maya, Model-pin docs -> @Liam. If anyone disagrees, reply inline.

Liam (PM): Agree. Adding note: quick UX spike for model catalog filters could be a half-sprint.

Maya (CS Ops): I'll attach the call recording links to the sheet and ping the customers for permission to share clips with eng.

Noah (CSE): I'll scope Dedicated cost ballpark and post in sheet by EOD.

Priya (CSM): Perfect. Closing this thread once owners confirm in the sheet. If you drop anything later, prefix with the bucket tag. :rocket:
